run_loop_agent_environment: run a DQN agent in an environment loop yielding timestep and action tuples per step
create_epsilon_greedy_actor: create an EpsilonGreedyActor agent with a Q-network, preprocessor, and exploration epsilon for action selection
track_episode_statistics: create an EpisodeTracker to accumulate and retrieve episode return, step count, and episode statistics
